ad.headline: Free shipping on every order.
ad.text: Gear up for the trail at Alder Trail Co. Shoes, jackets, socks, and packs.

phase: Reading the ad's promises (Muse Spark Open, open weights)

assertions.claim: Every order qualifies for free shipping

phase: Following the funnel like a customer (Muse Wonder · computer use)
Judging each promise against word-for-word evidence (Muse Wonder + quote check)

verdicts.pageQuote: Free shipping on orders of $150.00 or more
verdicts.reason: The page limits free shipping to orders of $150.00 or more, contradicting free shipping on every order.

fix.summary: Remove the $150.00 minimum from the free-shipping rule so every order ships free, as the ad promises.
fix.rationale: The ad promises free shipping on every order but the funnel limits it to $150.00 or more, so the shipping threshold is the hidden condition to fix.
steps: Open Store admin > Shipping settings > Free shipping rule and change Minimum order amount from $150.00 to $0 / No minimum.
Check: Reload the ridge-trail-shoe page and add an item under $150.00 to the cart; confirm the $150.00 threshold is gone and checkout shows $0 shipping.
